paper.title_en: Entanglement entropy of black holes from the first law of thermodynamics
paper.abstract_en: We compute the entanglement entropy of quantum matter in spacetimes with a Killing horizon entirely on-shell, by integrating the first law of thermodynamics along a one-parameter family of equilibrium backgrounds labelled by the Hawking temperature. This yields a closed expression in terms of the renormalized stress-energy tensor and the Killing vector, finite by construction, with no replicas and no conical singularities. Its covariant form agrees with the matter terms of the Bardeen--Carter--Hawking mass variation formula. We show in details that for static patch of de Sitter space and for the non-rotating BTZ black hole it reproduces the conical entropy exactly, contact term $Q$ included.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在壳上沿以 Hawking 温度为参数的平衡背景族积分第一定律，给出量子物质纠缠熵的封闭协变表达式，并将其与 Bardeen--Carter--Hawking 质量变分公式中的物质项对照，同时在 de Sitter 静态补丁与非旋转 BTZ 黑洞中逐项检验其与锥形熵（含接触项 Q）的精确一致，兼具热力学第一定律、纠缠熵与黑洞/视界热力学的理论深度与可检验性。
decision.title_zh: 从热力学第一定律出发的黑洞纠缠熵
decision.abstract_zh: 我们完全在壳上计算具有 Killing 视界的时空中量子物质的纠缠熵，方法是沿由 Hawking 温度标记的单参数平衡背景族对热力学第一定律进行积分。这给出了一个用重整化应力能量张量与 Killing 矢量表示的闭式表达式，按构造即为有限，且不涉及复制品方法与锥形奇点。其协变形式与 Bardeen--Carter--Hawking 质量变分公式中的物质项一致。我们详细证明，对于 de Sitter 空间的静态补丁以及非旋转 BTZ 黑洞，该表达式精确再现锥形熵，包括接触项 $Q$。
